M41 login changes (OAuth return, Business Portal sign-in link) apply only when an OAuth Client sign-in is in progress; ordinary staff sign-in lands on / as before (login.tsx).
limitations: The password lockout and both email budgets are database counters. They apply even when the lab sets AUTH_RATE_LIMIT=off, because that flag turns off only better-auth's own limiter. A walkthrough can observe them, but it should use a throwaway address: the lock lasts 15 minutes from the first wrong password.
The per-client-address budget (30 requests in 15 minutes across all addresses) is not described in the guide. It matters only for many people behind one address.
This sign-in link could not be used. needs an archived account or sign-in links turned off for the role, which is an organization or user change on the shared lab.
The registry's expired activation check is most practical as a used link: the invitation link lives one hour.
Session revocation after a password reset needs a second browser context that holds a session before the reset.
The organization name in the header is hidden below the md breakpoint; the walkthrough should use a desktop-width window.
The OAuth Client sign-in return (M41) is left to the Connect guides.
